messages.author: 628053524651bedc
messages.subject: Moderation: indProd() -centering
parts:
Hello all,

I am looking for some advice which centering method to use in the indProc() function.
Are there any guidelines when to use either no centering, mean centering, double-mean centering, or residual centering?

I ran a basic model. Even though I have a large sample with some missing values; I run MLR estimation. However, computation time is also comparatively high. Does the cloud version of RStudio computes faster than on my local machine?

semModel_Moderation <- "
  # Measurement Model
    DV_B  =~ B1 + B2 + B3 + B4 + B5
    DV_I =~ I1 + I2 + I3 + I4
    IV_A =~ A1 + A2 + A3 + A4 + A5
    IV_E =~ E1 + E2 + E3 + E4 + E5
    IV_T =~ T1 + T2 + T3 + T4 + T5 + T6
    Kongruenz       =~ C1 + C2 + C3

  # interaction terms
    KGxI           =~ C1.I1 + C1.I2 + C1.I3 + C1.I4 +
                       C2.I1 + C2.I2 + C2.I3 + C2.I4 +
                       C3.I1 + C3.I2 + C3.I3 + C3.I4     
    KGxA           =~ C1.A1 + C1.A2 + C1.A3 + C1.A4 + C1.A5 +
                       C2.A1 + C2.A2 + C2.A3 + C2.A4 + C2.A5 +
                       C3.A1 + C3.A2 + C3.A3 + C3.A4 + C3.A5    
    KGxE           =~ C1.E1 + C1.E2 + C1.E3 + C1.E4 + C1.E5 +
                       C2.E1 + C2.E2 + C2.E3 + C2.E4 + C2.E5 +
                       C3.E1 + C3.E2 + C3.E3 + C3.E4 + C3.E5
    KGxT           =~ C1.T1 + C1.T2 + C1.T3 + C1.T4 + C1.T5 + C1.T6 +
                       C2.T1 + C2.T2 + C2.T3 + C2.T4 + C2.T5 + C2.T6 +
                       C3.T1 + C3.T2 + C3.T3 + C3.T4 + C3.T5 + C3.T6

  # regressions
    DV_I ~ IV_A+ IV_E + IV_V + Kongruenz + KGxA + KGxE + KGxT
    DV_B ~ DV_I + Kongruenz  + KGxI

  # residual correlations
  "

Thanks for any feedback.

Carsten
